verified_facts.text: Athens Capital Hotel was the first MGallery Collection hotel in Greece.
verified_facts.excerpt: Athens Capital Hotel the first MGallery Collection Hotel in Greece, brings out the heart and soul of this cosmopolitan and vibrant city.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Syntagma Square, opposite the Parliament House.
verified_facts.excerpt: Well placed at Syntagma square, opposite to the Parliament House, the hotel recreates an effortless blend of art and business.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a few steps from Voukourestiou Street, home to famous boutiques.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a few steps away from the most high-end street of Athens, Voukourestiou Str, where you can find the most famous boutiques and shopping areas.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is next to the Plaka neighbourhood and close to Monastiraki and its traditional flea market.
verified_facts.excerpt: next to the historical and picturesque Plaka neighbourhood and just a heartbeat away from Monastiraki with its famous traditional flea market

verified_facts.text: Mappemonde, a work by Greek sculptor Georgios Lappas, is installed in the hotel's atrium, beginning on the tenth floor and running through all floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is led by Mappemonde, an emblematic life’s work by notable Greek sculptor Georgios Lappas, through an impressive installation that begins with its central component on the hotel’s tenth floor

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature Grecian marble, soft colors and Signature Artworks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grecian marble, soft colors, Signature Artworks, unmatched views and personal accents will stay with guests long after they have left

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite opens to a view of Lycabettus Hill and has a walk-in closet, a bathtub and a terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Presidential Suite (64 sq.m) open to a breathtaking view of the Lycabettus Hill. Equipped with a king size bed, a walk-in closet, a lounge area, a bathtub, a terrace

verified_facts.text: A Deluxe Room category comes with a king-size bed and a private balcony overlooking the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Deluxe Room with a king-size bed and private balcony invites you to relish the city’s vibrant skyline

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Room with private balcony offers a pillow menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: A pillow menu and an ironing board add to the comfort, making your stay one of serene luxury.

verified_facts.text: Mappemonde is a rooftop infinity pool bar with views of the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill.
verified_facts.excerpt: A birds-eye view elevates this rooftop infinity pool bar with its unbelievable view.

verified_facts.text: Mappemonde Restaurant Bar & Lounge serves signature dishes with a view to the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Signature dishes with unbelievable view

to Acropolis & Lycabettus Hill

verified_facts.text: MFlavours restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine and has an interactive open kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: MFlavours is the ideal culinary destination, to indulge in Mediterranean flavours in an authentic cosmopolitan decor which includes an interactive open kitchen

verified_facts.text: Galerie Cafe on the ground floor is a meeting point offering after-office cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: A perfect spot to relax, see and be seen, where luxury meets elegance and after office cocktails.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's M Moment is Greek komboloi storytelling followed by traditional Greek mezze.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Greek Komboloi storytelling followed

by
Greek traditional mezze

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes guests with pets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Hotel welcomes guests and their beloved pets - four-legged companions are treated as valued guests

verified_facts.text: The hotel celebrates Greek women who shaped history, including with a sculpture of the goddess Dimitra and suites dedicated to them.
verified_facts.excerpt: from a striking sculpture of goddess Dimitra to refined suites celebrating Greek women who shaped history

verified_facts.text: The hotel's signature cocktail, the Athenian Dream, combines Chios mastiha with lemon, honey and basil.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sweet Chios mastiha mingles with zesty lemon and honey, while fresh basil leaves add their aromatic touch.

verified_facts.text: Guests can follow the ancient path from the hotel towards the Acropolis.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stroll through beautiful Athenian surroundings and follow the ancient path towards Acropolis experiencing the cradle of Western civilization.

subjective.text: The hotel's Iconic Object is the Akrokeramon, a decorative element of Neoclassical Athens architecture that symbolizes hospitality.
